proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b P m n hm hn hP
  have hmn : 0 < m + n := by linarith
  have hsum : n / (m + n) + m / (m + n) = 1 := by field_simp; ring
  have h1 : P - a = (m / (m + n)) • (b - a) := by
    have : n / (m + n) = 1 - m / (m + n) := by linarith
    rw [hP, this]; module
  have h2 : b - P = (n / (m + n)) • (b - a) := by
    have : m / (m + n) = 1 - n / (m + n) := by linarith
    rw [hP, this]; module
  refine ⟨⟨n / (m + n), m / (m + n), by positivity, by positivity, hsum, hP.symm⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [h1, h2, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b P : V) (m n : ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → P = (n / (m + n)) • a + (m / (m + n)) • b → P ∈ segment ℝ a b ∧ n * ‖P - a‖ = m * ‖b - P‖
